create.name: Jurian Hughes
create.bio:
Jurian Hughes is a yoga, dance and voice teacher in the Berkshires of western Massachusetts and one of the longest-serving teachers at the Kripalu School of Yoga, where she has helped train well over a thousand yoga teachers since 2006. Before yoga became her vocation she worked for many years as an actor on and off Broadway, in film, television and voice-over, after studying at Williams College and taking an MFA at NYU's Tisch School. That stage background runs through her teaching: she founded the Yoga of Voice, which joins chanting, breath and posture with theatre voice work to help people speak and express themselves more freely, co-created The Yoga of Yes, and trains teachers in the Let Your Yoga Dance method.

Her classes are warm, candid and often funny, and they aim at joy and self-acceptance as much as at strength or flexibility. She teaches a live online gentle Kripalu class each week with recordings and a large on-demand library, sees students one to one at her home studio or online for yoga, voice coaching and mentoring, and has released recorded practices including a gentle Kripalu yoga video and a chakra yoga class. She leads weekend programmes at Kripalu several times a year and small-group retreats abroad, in places such as Mexico, Greece, Scotland and Kenya.

courses.title: Soul Nourishment: Pathways to Radical Hope
courses.description: A weekend at Kripalu in Stockbridge, Massachusetts, co-led with David Wallace for anyone feeling worn down by the times. Poetry, journaling, conversation, breath, meditation and dance are used to reconnect with a sense of hope and purpose.

courses.title: The First Dance: A New Year Weekend of Movement and Joy
courses.description: A New Year weekend at Kripalu built around free-form movement to music, with simple group chanting, breathwork and quiet. No dance experience is needed and there is no choreography to learn.

courses.title: Online Classes with Jurian
courses.description: A live gentle Kripalu yoga class on Zoom each Wednesday morning, with occasional pop-up dance sessions; every class is recorded for registrants. Passes also open a content library of several hundred recorded classes.
courses.price: $10–15 USD per class (pay what you can); monthly passes $45–75 USD; digital-only pass $30 USD per month

courses.title: Private Sessions
courses.description: One-to-one sessions in yoga, voice coaching, personal growth coaching, teacher mentoring or movement and dance. They take place at her home studio in the Berkshires, at the client's home, or online.
courses.price: From $100 USD per 60 minutes; five sessions $450 USD

courses.title: Self-Care Sanctuary: A Yoga Retreat for Every Body (Mexico)
courses.description: A week at Mar de Jade on the Pacific coast at Chacala, Mexico, with daily yoga, meditation and relaxation alongside dance, chanting and talks on yoga philosophy. Organised through One Yoga Global, with shared and private rooms.
courses.price: From $2,395 USD per person including lodging

courses.title: A Soulful Refuge on Paros Island (Greece)
courses.description: A week on the Greek island of Paros, co-led with David Wallace, mixing daily yoga for all levels, dance and chanting with his talks on ancient Greek myths. There is plenty of free time for the villages and the sea.
courses.price: From $2,995 USD per person sharing, including lodging

courses.title: Gentle Kripalu Yoga with Jurian Hughes
courses.description: A recorded 75-minute gentle class with centring, breathing practice, warm-ups, postures and a closing relaxation. Options are given throughout so that newcomers and long-time students can both follow it.

courses.title: Deep and Delicious Yoga with Jurian Hughes
courses.description: An hour-long audio yoga practice, gently moderate in pace, with breathing, a moving meditation and relaxation. Shakuhachi flute by Peter Ross plays throughout.

free_resources.title: Free Videos
free_resources.description: Jurian's own collection of free recorded practices, grouped into yoga, dance, voice and play. A good place to try her teaching before booking a class.
